description: A painted street scene: a woman in a dark coat, white dress and wide hat carries a tall banner with purple, gold and white bands, and leads a line of women in white dresses and sashes down a cobbled avenue with tram rails. A domed Capitol-like building stands in the hazy background, with American flags and bunting on the buildings. On the left, a crowd of men in suits and bowler hats presses in, some with raised fists. No visible text.
